video.title: AI欧腐《当深渊爱上光/Of Incubus and the Fall-Saint》
video.desc:
比之前碎碎的好点吧反正 
A youth is transported into a game world and becomes Adrian, last male incubus. Imprisoned with Holy Son Elias—corrupted by Abyss—he purifies him with his magic. To save his extinct race, Adrian disguises as a Holy Maiden and infiltrates the Church, joining forces with Elias to oppose the Pope, reclaim the sacred relic, and clear his race's stigma. The two break through fate and reach ending.
一名少年穿越进游戏世界，成了 Adrian——最后一个男性魅魔。他与被深渊侵蚀的圣子 Elias 一同被囚，以自身魔力净化了他。为了拯救濒临灭绝的种族，Adrian 伪装成圣女潜入教会，与 Elias 联手对抗教皇、夺回圣物、洗清魅魔一族的污名。两人冲破命运，走向结局。
